7. TROUBLESHOOTING
Symptom 1: The pump is not primed.
Cause: Air entering the suction pipe. Solution: Check the condition of connections and seals on the suction pipe.
Cause: Filter cap badly sealed. Solution: Clean the filter cap and check the condition of the rubber seal.
Cause: Motor turning in wrong direction. Solution: Invert 2 power phases.
Cause: Wrong voltage. Solution: Check the voltage on the rating plate and that of the mains.

7. TROUBLESHOOTING
Symptom 2: The pump only releases a small flow of water.
Cause: Air entering the suction pipe. Solution: Check the condition of connections and seals on the suction pipe.
Cause: Motor turning in wrong direction. Solution: Invert 2 power phases.
Cause: Wrong voltage. Solution: Check the voltage on the rating plate and that of the mains.
Cause: Pre-filter blocked. Solution: Clean the filter.
Cause: Load loss in the installation. Solution: Prevent parts from causing load loss wherever possible.

7. TROUBLESHOOTING
Symptom 3: The pump makes a noise.
Cause: Pump incorrectly secured. Solution: Secure the pump correctly.

7. TROUBLESHOOTING
Symptom 4: The pump will not start.
Cause: Wrong voltage. Solution: Check the voltage on the rating plate and that of the mains.

7. TROUBLESHOOTING
Symptom 5: The motor is making a noise but will not start.
Cause: Motor blocked. Solution: Remove the motor and contact the technical service.

7. TROUBLESHOOTING
Symptom 6: The motor has stopped.
Cause: Increased temperature in the terminal box due to electric arc. Solution: Check the junction box connections.
Cause: The thermal protection trips. Solution: Connect the cables correctly to the junction boxes.
Cause: Incorrect junction box connections. Solution: Tighten the cable correctly to the junction box / Adapt the size of the cable connection to the junction box.

Installation diagram (Fig. 4): the pump is installed above the pool water level and connected to the pool and to a filter. The height from the pool water level to the pump is at most 2 m (Max. 2 m).
Simplified transcription of a diagram; check the drawing on page 94 before installing.

INSTALLATION ZONES - Areas highlighted: the pump may be installed here.
Zone 0: the inside of the pool basin and of the foot bath.
Zone 1: from the edge of Zone 0 up to 2.0 m horizontally and up to 2.5 m high; around raised platforms such as diving boards and slides it extends 1.5 m horizontally and 2.5 m above them.
Zone 2: a band from 2.0 m to 3.5 m from the edge of Zone 0 (1.5 m wide), up to 2.5 m high.
In plan view, Zone 1 corners have a radius of 2.0 m and Zone 2 corners a radius of 3.5 m.
Only Zone 2 is highlighted: the pump may be installed in Zone 2, not in Zone 0 or Zone 1.
